Find projects by keywords and filters

Source: R/find.R
sq_find_projects.Rd

Search and filter projects across all databases without writing SQL. Combines free-text keyword matching with structured filters on organism, assay type, year, country, and more.

sq_find_projects(
  con,
  keywords = NULL,
  organism = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  year_from = NULL,
  year_to = NULL,
  min_samples = NULL,
  min_citations = NULL,
  sort_by = "relevance",
  limit = 100
)

Arguments

con

A seqout_connection from connect_seqout().

keywords

Optional character. Search terms matched against project titles and descriptions (case-insensitive). Multiple words are split and each must appear (AND logic), e.g. "liver cancer scRNA" finds projects containing all three terms.

organism

Optional character. Scientific name (e.g., "Homo sapiens", "Mus musculus"). Use sq_list_organisms() to discover valid values.

assay

Optional character. Assay type to filter by. Matched against both broad categories (e.g., "Transcriptomic") and specific assays (e.g., "RNA-seq", "ChIP-seq"). Use sq_list_assays() to discover valid values.

source

Optional character. Database source: "geo", "sra", "ena", or "ae" (ArrayExpress).

country

Optional character. Country name (e.g., "United States", "China"). Use sq_list_countries() to discover valid values.

year_from, year_to

Optional integer. Filter by publication year range.

min_samples

Optional integer. Minimum number of samples.

min_citations

Optional integer. Minimum citation count.

sort_by

How to sort results: "relevance" (default, by citation count), "date" (newest first), "samples" (most samples first), or "citations".

limit

Maximum number of results to return. Default 100.

Value

A tibble with columns: accession, source, title, organism, assay, country, published, n_samples, citation_count.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- connect_seqout()

# Find human RNA-seq cancer projects
sq_find_projects(con,
  keywords = "cancer", organism = "Homo sapiens",
  assay = "RNA-seq"
)

# Recent mouse ChIP-seq with many samples
sq_find_projects(con,
  organism = "Mus musculus", assay = "ChIP-seq",
  year_from = 2022, min_samples = 20, sort_by = "date"
)

# Highly cited single-cell projects
sq_find_projects(con,
  keywords = "single cell",
  min_citations = 100, sort_by = "citations"
)
} # }
